resources.string: Opens the app you choose when the TV starts or wakes from standby.
If the home screen covers your app after waking, increase the delay.

Android may block opening apps from the background without it. Try the button below. If your TV has no such screen, grant it from a computer with adb:\nadb shell appops set %1$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
This TV has no settings screen for this permission. Use the adb command shown.
Could not open the app. It may have been uninstalled.
No internet permission. Your choice is stored only on this TV and never leaves it.
Waiting for the TV to wake up
Done! %1$s will open when the TV turns on.
